title: Meridian Coffee
description: A complete identity for a single-origin roastery — wordmark, packaging system, and a stencil-inspired display face used across the retail estate.
alt: Meridian Coffee brand identity — stacked typographic poster in warm cream and terracotta

title: Northline Type
description: A condensed grotesque drawn for editorial headlines. Six weights, tightly fitted, built to hold a front page without shouting.
alt: Northline typeface specimen — condensed grotesque lettering on a dark ground

title: Kite Festival
description: Twelve screen-printed posters for an annual coastal festival. Each print reuses one grid and one ink change.
alt: Kite Festival poster — geometric circle and rule composition in muted blue

title: Studio Alba
description: Identity and stationery for an architecture practice. A modular grid mark that rearranges to sit on any format.
alt: Studio Alba visual identity — modular grid of squares in olive and stone

title: Field Notes
description: Art direction and layout for a quarterly journal on landscape and ecology. 96 pages, two inks, one typeface.
alt: Field Notes editorial spread — diagonal colour fields in crimson and charcoal

title: Halcyon Records
description: Sleeve artwork for a nine-record ambient series. Concentric arcs mapped to the running time of each side.
alt: Halcyon Records album artwork — concentric arcs in ink blue and off-white

title: Terra Botanics
description: Packaging for a botanical skincare range. Uncoated stock, blind deboss, and a strict two-colour palette.
alt: Terra Botanics packaging design — stacked bars in warm sand and clay

title: Civic Museum
description: A wayfinding system for a city museum. Large-format signage, floor plates, and a pictogram set drawn from scratch.
alt: Civic Museum wayfinding — bold diagonal signage panels in amber and black

title: Ember & Ash
description: Identity for a wood-fired restaurant. Hand-cut letterforms, warm neutrals, and a menu system that ages with the room.
alt: Ember & Ash brand identity — circular mark in ember red over a rule
